title: Pick several album photos at once
body: The photo pages (job album, claim album, room detail, and the job/claim photo sections) now let you select several pictures from your phone's album in one pass instead of adding them one at a time. On the phone, Add Photo asks whether to take a new picture or choose from the album; on the web the file picker allows multi-select. Photos upload one after another, and if some fail you're told exactly how many made it ("3 of 5 photos uploaded"). The quick-capture buttons on the Dashboard and Job Hub still jump straight to a single shot.
